<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "RootEntity">
  <!ENTITY nested "&base;Extended">
  <!ENTITY % param '
    <!ELEMENT dynamic (#PCDATA)>
    <!ENTITY dynEnt "DynamicEntityValue">
  '>
  %param;
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://xml.org/db" xmlns:data="http://xml.org/db/data" data:version="2.0">
  <!-- Database documentation comment -->
  <?data:log action="initialize"?>
  <record>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw data stream with markup: <record> &nested; </record>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <data:dynamic>&dynEnt;</data:dynamic>
</database>

]>

  ">

  <?debug-pi mode="verbose"?>
]>
<config xmlns="urn:config:base" xmlns:cfg="urn:config:ns">
  <!-- Configuration file comment header -->
  <?cfg:processor step="parse"?>
  <setting>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment-like structure inside CDATA --!>
      &e2;
    ]]>
  </setting>
  <cfg:subconfig>&ent-in-pe;</cfg:subconfig>
</config>
